Initial release of test-openapi, an async-first Python SDK for the Fotor OpenAPI.

- Provides scripts for installing the SDK, running single or batch tasks, and uploading images.
- Supports image and video generation, editing, and enhancement via Fotor OpenAPI.
- Built-in automatic model fallback for common failure cases.
- Comprehensive references and usage examples, including parameter validation and workflow guidance.
- Available task types include text2image, image2image, text2video, image upscaling, and more.
